entities.summary: Reinhard Oehme was a German-American physicist known for the discovery of C non-conservation in the presence of P (parity) violation, the formulation and proof of hadron dispersion relations, the edge-of-the-wedge theorem in the function theory of several complex variables, the Goldberger–Miyazawa–Oehme sum rule, reduction of quantum field theories, Oehme–Zimmermann superconvergence relations for gauge field correlation functions, and many other contributions.
